page.layout: One column of text on a single printed page. Each entry is a bare number, then an italic keyword with a bracket, then a gloss and a scripture reference. A vertical side title runs down the right margin. Running head at top left, page number at top right.

page.notes: The leading mark before "Artes perpetuæ" and "Ambitio noxia" is an ornamental letter or sign that I could not identify; I have omitted it. "Inscantes" is doubtful: the printed letters are unclear and may be a misprint. The side title IESVITARVM. is set vertically in the right margin and is recorded as a note. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, including "Bosor", read from the long-s form. Hyphenated line breaks are joined: "adulterii", "nebulæ", "inescant". Printed spelling, including "verè" and "quæ", is kept as printed.
